warning.titlePre: Jaguar S-Type R Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ-V8 (supercharged) is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ-V8 (supercharged) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V8 (supercharged) rebuild.
Because the S-Type R uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the S-Type 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ-V8 (supercharged) specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
